values: CREATE INDEX item_sort ON items(library_id,kind,key,id) WHERE kind IN(1,2,3,4,10)
CREATE TABLE items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, library_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind INTEGER NOT NULL, key INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE labels(item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT)
CREATE TABLE principals(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,library_id INTEGER NOT NULL)

manifest.sql: SELECT i.id,p.id,l.value FROM items AS i INDEXED BY item_sort CROSS JOIN principals AS p INDEXED BY principal_library ON p.library_id=i.library_id AND p.id=? LEFT JOIN labels AS l NOT INDEXED ON l.item_id=i.id WHERE i.library_id=? AND i.kind=? AND kind IN(1,2,3,4,10) AND i.key=? ORDER BY i.key,i.id LIMIT ?
